resources.string: Screen time
See which apps you use and for how long.

Loop reads how long each app was open and how often you unlock your phone, the same numbers Digital Wellbeing shows. It also helps work out when you fell asleep.\n\nLoop never sees what you do inside an app.
On the next screen, find Loop and turn on \"Permit usage access\".
Physical activity
Count steps and notice walks, runs and rides.

Loop uses your phone\'s step counter and motion detection to log steps and walks on its own, without you opening the app. It also tells Loop when the phone has been still at night, which helps with sleep.
Health Connect
Bring in steps, workouts, sleep and heart rate from your watch.
If you wear a watch or use another fitness app, Loop can read that data from Health Connect. Loop only reads: it never writes to Health Connect or shares anything.
Notification access
Count notifications and notice when music is playing.
Loop counts how many notifications each app sends and notes when music starts and stops, so it can show your listening time.\n\nLoop doesn\'t keep the text of your notifications.
On the next screen, turn on access for Loop.
Notifications
Gentle reminders and one-tap check-ins.
A few short notes a day, like a mood check-in or \"did you sleep at 11:40?\", that you can answer right from the notification. You choose how many, and quiet hours keep your nights silent.
Location
Know when you reach the gym, office or home.
You save a few places once. Android then tells Loop when you arrive or leave.\n\nLoop doesn\'t track your route, and GPS is never left running.
Location, all the time
Log gym visits and office hours even when Loop is closed.
Arrival and leaving alerts only work if Android can tell Loop while it\'s in the background. Loop uses this for your saved places only.
On the next screen, choose \"Allow all the time\".
Turn on Location first.
Camera
Snap a meal to log it.
Take a photo of your plate and Loop fills in what\'s on it. The camera is only used when you open the food camera yourself.
Run in the background
Stop your phone pausing Loop and leaving gaps in your day.
Some phones pause apps to save battery, which leaves holes in your data. Loop is built to be light: it checks in every 15 minutes at most, never keeps GPS on, and never uses the microphone.
On the next screen, pick \"All apps\", find Loop and choose \"Don\'t optimise\".
